note: Companies whose tracked jobs the importer may use: only companies that are BOTH a Fortune 500 company AND FINRA-regulated. This local file is a fallback and ships EMPTY on purpose. The authoritative list is the backend's reviewed one, backend/src/main/resources/market/allow-list.json; when that file exists the importer reads it instead of this one, so edit that file, not this (see docs/JOBSYNC_IMPORTER.md). The importer never guesses a company's status: in this file's format an entry counts only when both 'fortune500' and 'finraRegulated' are literally true, and a company matches only by its name or a listed alias (case, punctuation and legal suffixes such as Inc. or & Co. are ignored; nothing fuzzy). Add only companies you have checked yourself, for example on the Fortune 500 list and FINRA BrokerCheck, and note where in 'source'.
